notes.title: Breathing Life into World 2 of Emptiness Sire
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone! [/p][p align="start"]As we continue exploring [b]World 2[/b], we’d like to shift the focus to a part of development that often speaks louder than words: the art. For us, visuals are not just about setting the stage 🎨 they’re about making the world of [b]Emptiness Sire[/b] feel alive, unsettling, and meaningful.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193439/5f5d09e2857b9f9b3e056cbf04efe05b04f9e766.png"][/img][/p][p]Our art team has been fully dedicated to building an atmosphere where [b]every element feels intentional.[/b] From spores that pulse as if breathing, to plants twisted into strange mutations, to waterfalls and lakes that carry both beauty and dread 💀 nothing is placed without purpose. [b]These details aren’t just decoration; they are fragments of the lore, silent storytellers woven into the environment.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193439/16ea7a86d803c699560ea16b653519e484162efe.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193439/5774fd7b1e45b2217cb79c1f0a0abdca127c30c1.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193439/009046251780a123e023f3ae4b08e37590d271d7.png"][/img][/p][p]Just like the enemies you face and the dialogues you encounter, [b]every asset created from scratch is a piece of the puzzle that reveals what Emptiness Sire truly is.[/b] [b]The world itself becomes a character, whispering its secrets through symbols, movements, and the spaces it leaves behind.[/b][/p][p align="start"]We’ll be sharing some images so you can take a closer look at these details. Keep in mind that each of them has something to say — if you’re willing to observe closely...👁️[/p][p align="start"]See you in the next update, where we’ll continue uncovering what lies beyond.[/p][p align="start"]— Team Oaks[/p]

notes.title: Into the Darkness of World 2
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p align="start"]Continuing from our last updates about World 2 — and if you missed them, we recommend checking those out to learn more about its mechanics and the new presence players will face — this time we’d like to focus on the world itself.[/p][p align="start"]In Emptiness Sire, environments are never just backdrops. They carry meaning, symbols, and fragments of a story that slowly reveal themselves as you progress. In World 2, this becomes even clearer. What felt subtle in World 1 now takes a darker and more oppressive form: strange symbols etched into stone, candles illuminating forgotten corners, and scattered remains of structures that hint at what once stood there.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193439/6377fe5b624058774d98ffb07d62e169e8e876e4.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]These elements aren’t just decoration — they connect directly with the mechanics and heighten the sense of tension, making each puzzle feel like part of something deeper. With every move, players aren’t only reasoning through solutions; they’re also piecing together an atmosphere filled with unease and mystery.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193439/1c0524eb3dbc0b6f059f7101d4144d4961aa7110.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]World 2 marks a clear shift in tone and intention. From the cooler, darker palette to the narrative traces hidden in its details, everything contributes to immersing players in a world that feels both haunting and inevitable.[/p][p align="start"]We’ll be sharing some images alongside this post so you can catch glimpses of this atmosphere taking shape.[/p][p align="start"]See you in the next update![/p][p align="start"]— Team Oaks[/p]

notes.title: A new presence in World 2
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone! 👋[/p][p align="start"]Over the past weeks, [b]we’ve been shaping the atmosphere of World 2[/b] — refining its puzzles, introducing pistons and levers, and weaving deeper narrative details into the environment. But this chapter also marks the arrival of something…different.[/p][p align="start"]For the first time, you won’t just be solving puzzles or facing familiar enemies. Instead, [b]you’ll meet a new kind of presence — one that’s faster, smarter, and far more relentless than anything you’ve encountered so far.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193439/8aeee52c5ea0df01646ade27116f45ad3492b35c.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][b]This creature is not born in the usual sense. It is summoned. Once conjured, it clings to its host and manifests in a physical form, pursuing its chosen target with unyielding determination.[/b] It doesn’t lose track. It doesn’t forgive. It doesn’t stop.[/p][p align="start"]More than a simple obstacle, [b]this entity adds a layer of tension and unpredictability to the gameplay.[/b] Every move matters when something that knows exactly where you are is chasing you.[/p][p align="start"]And this is only the beginning. In our next update, we’ll talk about how this chapter becomes a turning point — not just in terms of challenge, but also in the visual identity of Emptiness Sire.[/p][p align="start"]For now, let’s just say that [b]World 2 will test your wits, your patience, and perhaps even your sense of safety within these forgotten worlds.[/b][/p][p align="start"]See you soon, with glimpses of what lies beyond the void 👀[/p][p align="start"]— Team Oaks[/p]

notes.title: Pistons, levers, and what’s coming in World 2
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Over the past two weeks, we’ve been deeply focused on [b]finalizing World 2[/b] and refining the ideas for World 3 👁️ and we can already tell these two chapters will feel very different from each other.[/p][p][b]In World 2, we introduced two new mechanics: pistons and levers.[/b] While they weren’t the most technically demanding to implement, our focus was on making sure they felt intuitive to the player, added meaningful variety to the puzzles, and above all, made sense within the world and narrative unfolding at this point in the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193439/6275da65dbfd8ddb85c3d25a64e03b1d6fc07175.png"][/img][/p][p]These mechanics bring a new rhythm to the gameplay, [b]creating interactions that are both strategic and surprising[/b] 😃 and they help reinforce the themes and mood that define this part of the journey.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193439/a1792bdd05dad757725cba69ea289127bd89229f.png"][/img][/p][p]We also took this time to enrich the world with key narrative elements, subtly embedded in the environment and progression. Without giving too much away, [b]World 2 marks an emotional and symbolic shift[/b] 🧩 and we’re really excited for you to explore it.[/p][p]And yes, we’ve already started shaping World 3 😵‍💫😵‍💫 and it’s there that things get a bit more complex. But we’ll talk more about that soon.[/p][p]Thanks for following along! In the next post, who knows, maybe we’ll share a visual sneak peek? 👀[/p][p]— Team Oaks[/p]

notes.title: Mechanics, atmosphere, and what’s coming next in Emptiness Sire
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]Today we want to share a bit about the [b]mechanics[/b] that make [b]Emptiness Sire[/b] a unique experience.[/p][p]At its core, our game is a [b]2D turn-based puzzle[/b]. Every move matters  and every mistake can (and should) be reconsidered. That’s why we created the [b]undo system[/b], which allows players to rewind their last steps, correct decisions, and explore different paths without the frustration of restarting an entire level.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193439/5946d2e80e53e2cc70b835b02d4090348706b605.png"][/img][/p][p]Beyond that, [b]Emptiness Sire[/b] is built around contrasting atmospheres and worlds with their own rules. The combination of challenging puzzles, an enigmatic narrative, and carefully crafted environments turns each level into a piece of a greater puzzle 🧩 not just of logic, but of meaning.[/p][p]We’re really excited to hear what you’ll think once the demo is out. Honestly, we can’t wait! There’s no set release date yet, but we’re working hard and staying focused to make it available as soon as possible.[/p][p]In the meantime, we’re deep into developing Worlds 2 and 3, which will bring entirely different atmospheres compared to what you’ve seen so far. New mechanics, new characters, new challenge 🎮 it’s all on the way.[/p][p]In our next update, we’ll share a few light spoilers about what’s coming.[/p][p]Thanks again for following along on this journey with us.[/p][p]— Team Oaks[/p]

notes.title: Welcome to the world of Emptiness Sire 🧩
notes.notes: [p]Welcome to the [b]official Emptiness Sire blog[/b]! 😄 Our space to share news, reflections, and behind-the-scenes insights about the adventure of creating a [b]tactical puzzle game[/b] from scratch. 🎮[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="V143My8hL3o;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]We’re a small independent team from Brazil[/b], 🇧🇷 completely passionate about experiences that blend strategy, narrative, and mystery.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Emptiness Sire[/b] was born as a college project, [b]inspired by[/b] classic works of science fiction, the decaying beauty of forgotten worlds, and, of course, games that left a mark on us, like [b]Lara Croft Go [/b]and[b] Hades[/b].[/p][p]Starting now, we’ll be posting updates every two weeks. On this blog, you can expect:[/p][p]🧩 Development updates;[/p][p]🧩 Behind-the-scenes and curiosities;[/p][p]🧩 Recommendations of other great games (especially if you love puzzles and strange narratives);[/p][p]🧩 And, whenever possible, small previews of what’s to come;[/p][p][/p][p]We’re just getting started, but [b]we already want to thank every single person who added the game to their wishlist[/b], left a comment, or shared something about it. That support means the world to us as we keep building this with care and heart. 🤎[/p][p][/p][p]If you enjoy games that mix [b]challenge, adventure, and mystery, Emptiness Sire[/b] might just be your next favorite dive.[/p][p]See you soon with our first content update![/p][p]— [b]Team Oaks[/b][/p]
